seoTitle: How to Fix "Model Not Found" Error in ChatGPT
metaDescription: Fix the ChatGPT "Model Not Found" error step by step: log out and back in, clear cookies and cache, disable VPN or extensions, and check your connection.
intro: The 'Model Not Found' error in ChatGPT often shows up after upgrading, switching accounts, or enabling a new plan, and it's usually fixable without contacting support. This guide walks through the step-by-step process that resolves the issue for most users.

steps.heading: Log out and log back in
steps.body: Signing out and back into your ChatGPT account refreshes your model access and resolves the error for most users.

steps.heading: Clear browser cookies and cache
steps.body: Stale cookies or cached session data can cause ChatGPT to reference an outdated model list, so clearing them often fixes the issue.

steps.heading: Disable VPN or browser extensions
steps.body: Ad blockers, privacy extensions, or an active VPN can interfere with ChatGPT's requests, so temporarily disabling them can rule out this cause.

steps.heading: Check your internet connection
steps.body: An unstable connection can cause requests to fail partway through, triggering the error, so confirm your connection is stable before retrying.

steps.heading: Retry after switching accounts or plans
steps.body: If the error appeared right after upgrading to a plan like ChatGPT Go or switching accounts, give it a few minutes and retry, since access changes can take a moment to sync.

faq.question: Why does ChatGPT show 'Model Not Found' after upgrading?
faq.answer: This often happens because your account's model access hasn't fully refreshed yet — logging out and back in usually resolves it.

faq.question: Does clearing cookies delete my ChatGPT chat history?
faq.answer: No, clearing browser cookies and cache affects your browser session, not your saved chat history stored on your account.

faq.question: Can a VPN cause this ChatGPT error?
faq.answer: Yes, an active VPN can sometimes interfere with how requests reach ChatGPT's servers, so disabling it is worth testing.

faq.question: What if the error persists after trying all these fixes?
faq.answer: If the issue continues after logging back in, clearing cache, and disabling extensions or VPN, it may be a temporary account sync delay that resolves on its own shortly after.
